_comment: The other side of the underscore rule: a repository file may legitimately be named with a leading underscore. Written as a relative import it resolves to an in-repo path, so it stays seam-eligible — the rule is about package specifiers, not about the character.

The state is read before the await and `writeThing` runs after it, so a concurrent close wins the race and nothing revalidates it in between.
